Anr. seeking further enhancement in compensation amount and modification to the extent thereof in the impugned judgment arising out of the award bearing no. 25/2005-06/DC(N-W) pertaining to village Kirari Suleman Nagar (Patti Nithari), Delhi.

sentences.text: 7. Issue notice.

8. Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel appearing for respondent no. 1/Union of India,
accepts notice.

Ms. Mrinalini Sen, Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no.
2/DDA, accepts notice.

9. The counsel for the appellant stated that the connected appeal bearing LA APP. no. 667/2023 titled as Ajit Singh (Deceased) Through LRs V Union of India & Anr. pertaining to the same village and award has already been admitted and the same is ordered to be listed in the category of 'Regular Matters'.
10.

The present appeal is also admitted for hearing and be listed in the category of 'Regular Matters'
in due course along with other connected appeals.
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J MAY 16, 2024 sk/am
